summary: Completed Module 07 BREAK in progress/decomposition/module-07/break-diagnosis.md. Diagnosed the second requirement shock (Meridian IT director requiring 3-role RBAC: Manager, Employee, Department Head), escalated User Data Model and Auth/JWT from MINOR to MAJOR, cut all remaining SHOULD SHIP items (email notifications, provider calendar view, self-serve department admin UI), revised the PM impact statement, and formulated the Typed Role Bridge architecture preserving the 6-day investor demo milestone.
evidence: Identified new artifacts affected: NestJS RolesGuard, department query filters, and 3-tier corporate seed personas.
Escalated User Model and Booking Model from MINOR to MAJOR (CompanyRole enum + department string).
Cut Provider Attendee Email (CUT-05), Calendar View (CUT-06), and Dynamic Admin UI (CUT-07) to absorb 14h of RBAC work.
Revised PM communication setting explicit boundary between static demo role-scoping (supported in 6 days) vs dynamic self-serve admin console (unsupported in 6 days).
Justified why pure boolean Option B collapsed and why full relational Option A is lethal, landing on the pragmatic Typed Role Bridge.
